summary: The web app's main area becomes a persisted tab strip over the workspace tab model, replacing its per-agent panes and phone tabs

replay.detail: Web client only; no replay or rebuild.

schema.detail: No server schema changes. The browser starts a new device-local tab document; the old selected-agent, per-agent pane and phone-tab keys are no longer read, so open tabs start empty once.

compatibility.detail: Old `/w/...?open=` links still open their subject. Pane keys match the terminal client's; no wire changes.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous shell; the tab document is ignored.
